subject: Incoming Sixth Grade Virtual Open House
overview: School administrators, teachers, and student ambassadors hosted a remote open house for incoming sixth-grade students and their families. The presentation featured a prerecorded tour and overview of the school followed by a live panel answering questions about academics, schedules, and student life.

items.title: Welcome and School Overview Video
items.summary: Principal Tucci and school staff introduced the McGlynn Middle School structure, covering the academic team system, daily eight-period schedule, unified arts rotations, and extracurricular offerings.

items.title: Academic Teaming, Facilities, and Student Perspectives
items.summary: Teachers and students showcased the two-team model for incoming sixth graders, library programs, and music electives, offering advice on adjusting to middle school life.

items.title: Live Panel Question and Answer Forum
items.summary: Administrators, faculty, and student ambassadors answered questions from viewers regarding morning arrival, lockers, academic support, club participation, sports eligibility, and August orientation plans.
